tasks.subject: Task 0: Fix CSS variables
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/goods-inwards.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 3: Cost update modal on receipt detail
tasks.description:
**Goal:** After saving a receipt, show a modal on the detail page when lines have costs, letting the user selectively update component prices.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/receipt-detail.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/[id]/page.tsx`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/goods-inwards.module.css`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `updateComponentCosts` action updates `component.cost_per_unit` for given IDs
- [ ] Modal appears on detail page mount when any line has `cost_per_unit` and hasn't been dismissed
- [ ] Modal lists per-line checkboxes with component name and receipt cost
- [ ] Confirming updates only checked components; skipping does nothing
- [ ] Modal does not reappear after dismissal (localStorage key `dismissed_cost_modal_<receipt_id>`)

**Verify:** Create a receipt with cost fields, navigate to detail, modal should appear. Click skip — modal gone. Refresh — modal stays gone.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts", "src/app/app/goods-inwards/receipt-detail.tsx", "src/app/app/goods-inwards/[id]/page.tsx", "src/app/app/goods-inwards/goods-inwards.module.css"], "verifyCommand": "", "acceptanceCriteria": ["updateComponentCosts action works", "Modal appears on mount when lines have costs", "Modal dismissed permanently via localStorage", "Update selected updates only checked components"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: PDF upload + parse action
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a 'Parse delivery docket' section to the receipt form that uses the Anthropic API to pre-fill supplier reference, date, and line quantities.

**Files:**
- Modify: `package.json`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts`
- Modify: `src/app/app/goods-inwards/receipt-form.tsx`
- Modify: `.env.local` (user must add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY manually)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `@anthropic-ai/sdk` is installed
- [ ] `parseReceiptPdf` returns parsed data on valid PDF
- [ ] `parseReceiptPdf` returns `{ error: string }` on failure
- [ ] Form shows PDF file input + Parse button above header fields
- [ ] On success: `supplier_reference` and `received_at` are pre-filled with [parsed] badge
- [ ] Lines from PDF have `quantity_delivered` set and read-only extracted name; component dropdown blank
- [ ] Errors display inline without clearing form
- [ ] Files over 10 MB rejected client-side

**Verify:** Upload a real delivery docket PDF and confirm supplier reference, date and lines are pre-filled.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "src/app/app/goods-inwards/actions.ts", "src/app/app/goods-inwards/receipt-form.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "npm run build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["@anthropic-ai/sdk installed", "parseReceiptPdf works", "PDF section renders above header fields", "Pre-fill works on success", "Errors shown inline", "10MB limit enforced"]}
```
